_selection_reason: GRU has lowest MAE/RMSE at t+60min and t+120min, the two longest validated horizons -- most relevant for maintenance planning use. Persistence wins at t+5min/t+30min but a 'no change' forecast has no planning value. Trend regression and exponential smoothing lose to naive persistence at every horizon, confirming no simple linear/smoothed trend exists to exploit -- consistent with the earlier finding of no long-term degradation trend (r^2=0.037 globally).
_validated_horizon_limit_reason: Longest contiguous scoreable operating session in the entire dataset is 163 points (~13.6 hours); mean session length is only ~2.4 hours. No session in the data reaches 24 hours, so a 24-hour-ahead forecast target literally cannot be trained or validated on this machine's real operating pattern, independent of model choice.
